name: chatgpt-workspace-agents
description: Build and manage ChatGPT Workspace Agents (ChatGPT Business / Enterprise / Edu) from Claude Code by driving the agent builder at chatgpt.com/agents/studio in a browser: create, inspect, list, update (instructions, files, skills, apps) and share agents. There is no public API for editing agents, so this is browser automation and will break when the UI changes.
